current_implementation: windows_folder_integration.rs enlists all HKCU registry prefixes including Software and its owned receipt in one native transaction. Native NSIS scopes pass; MSIX19 reported unavailable transaction resource manager.

primary_sources.finding: Microsoft documents package registry writes being redirected to a private per-user hive for virtualized applications.
Windows11 supports selected HKCU exclusions; older supported systems require broader opt-out. Both require the restricted unvirtualizedResources capability.

inference: Virtualized registry behavior is a plausible package-specific factor, but the failure is not yet isolated from guest environment or registry container behavior. Do not remove transaction guarantees or add broad capabilities on this inference.
next_control: Compare exact API failure and owned-key rollback/commit under packaged versus ordinary identity on the same clean guest, capturing operation and numeric error. Then verify external shell visibility and uninstall restoration with the chosen supported integration.
